issuance: five fixed per-wallet allocations; owner-authorized; each allocation one-time; no additional minting
releaseConstraints: The VCoinMaster StateInit permanently fixes the five destination addresses.
The Master accepts only the exact approved amount for the matching destination wallet.
Each allocation can be issued once; only that allocation can be retried after an authenticated natural bounce.
After all five wallet credits succeed, minting is permanently disabled.
Never send Mainnet transactions from CI.
Verify the deployed Master allocation config against the approved operational register before signing any issuance messages.
Reconcile each Jetton wallet balance against this manifest after issuance.
The Founder allocation wallet is also the GAS & OPERATIONS wallet; it is not a sixth destination. The Founder alone signs deployment and each separate issuance request.
The founder/owner signs each VCoinMint request with at least 0.01 TON; the Master reserve funds 0.1 TON for each destination wallet credit.
Execution is Mainnet-only after all release gates; no Testnet deployment or Testnet transaction is authorized. Local TON Sandbox tests are required.
